requirements.text: A customer shall be able to register with a name, email and password.
A customer shall be able to browse products by category.
A customer shall be able to place an order containing one or more products.
A customer shall be able to cancel an order before it is shipped.
The system shall accept card payments for an order.
An administrator shall be able to add, update and remove products.
A library member shall be able to search the catalogue by title, author or ISBN.
A member shall be able to borrow up to five books at a time.
A member shall be able to return a borrowed book.
The system shall calculate a fine for books returned after the due date.
A librarian shall be able to register new books and members.
A patient shall be able to book an appointment with a doctor.
A patient shall be able to cancel or reschedule an appointment.
A doctor shall be able to record a diagnosis and issue a prescription.
A receptionist shall be able to view the daily appointment schedule.
The system shall send an appointment reminder to the patient one day before.
